'''Taym Dren-garen''' was one of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] henchmen.

==Biography==
A [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] of the<ref name="CSWE" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Tatooine">{{DB|location|tatooine|Tatooine}}</ref> [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]],<ref name="CSWE" /> the [[Human/Legends|Human]] sharpshooter Taym Dren-garen was a lackey of the<ref name="Insider" /> [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]]<ref name="Jabba">{{FactFile|38|JAB 1-4|Jabba the Hutt}}</ref> [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. Dren-garen's job was to deal directly with [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]], nomads<ref name="Insider" /> indigenous to Tatooine.<ref name="Tatooine" /> Fueling the Tusken Raider's tempers with lies about local settlers, Dren-garen kept them well supplied<ref name="Insider" /> with weapons.<ref name="CSWE" /> He kept local authorities distracted from Jabba's operations by promoting skirmishes between the Tuskens and the settlers.<ref name="Insider" />

In the year [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|VI}} to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> Dren-garen was present in the throne room of [[Jabba's palace]] while the [[Max Rebo Band/Legends|Max Rebo Band]] performed "[[Jedi Rocks/Legends|Jedi Rocks]]". The sharpshooter stood near the<ref name="RotJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> [[Security officer/Legends|security officer]] [[Vul Tazaene]]<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Jabba's Palace Limited|cardname=Vul Tazaene}}</ref> and talked with<ref name="RotJ" /> him<ref name="CCG" /> as the band closed out their performance. [[Joh Yowza/Legends|Joh Yowza]], a singer for the band, restarted their performance after misinterpreting Jabba ordering his enslaved dancer [[Oola/Legends|Oola]] to repeat her performance. Shortly after, Oola would be fed to [[Jabba's rancor/Legends|Jabba's rancor]] after refusing to sit with him.<ref name="JN">[[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi (junior novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'' junior novelization]]</ref> While she was eaten, Dren-garen and other individuals in the room gathered around and watched as the feeding happened.<ref name="RotJ" />

During the planned execution of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] over the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]], Skywalker equipped himself with a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] previously hidden in the [[Astromech droid/Legends|Astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. He began fighting his way through several of Jabba's henchmen, in an attempt to free his friends and himself from Jabba's control.<ref name="RotJ" />

After already witnessing several of his fellow henchmen fall by Skywalker's lightsaber, Dren-garen found the opportunity to disable the attacker. As [[Klaatu/Legends|Klaatu]] retreated into the main hold, Dren-garen erupted from a top-mounted hatch at the front of the deck from behind Skywalker, catching him completely off guard. Dren-garen shot Skywalker's right hand, at the moment Skywalker raised his green-bladed saber above his head. Skywalker struck out at Taym with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], slashing him across his weapon-holding hand. With a howl of pain, Taym Dren-garen fell backwards through the hatch into the depths of the [[Khetanna/Legends|''Khetanna'']].<ref name="RotJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
Taym Dren-garen was portrayed by [[Larry Holt]] in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Return of the Jedi'']]''. ''Larry Holt also portrayed Sergeant [[Bruckman/Legends|Bruckman]].<ref name="RotJ" />

In the non-[[canon]]ical comic ''[[The Return of Tag & Bink: Special Edition]]'' Taym's role is replaced by [[Bink Otauna/Legends|Bink Otauna]], who was wearing the same clothes.<ref name="The Return of Tag & Bink: Special Edition">''[[The Return of Tag & Bink: Special Edition]]''</ref>
